title: Berlin Museum Pass vs. Single Tickets - Quick Summary
items: Single tickets to the open Museum Island museums cost **€14–€16** each. If you plan to visit two or more, individual tickets are not worth it.
The **Museum Island day pass (€24, reduced €12)** covers all four open museums plus Pergamonmuseum. Das Panorama in one day. It pays for itself after just two visits.
The **Museumspass Berlin (€32, reduced €16)** gives you three days of access to 30+ museums city-wide. It does not cover Das Panorama.

The **Pergamonmuseum is completely closed** since 23 October 2023. The north wing reopens 4 June 2027; the Ishtar Gate is not expected back until around 2037. Only **Pergamonmuseum. Das Panorama** (€14) is open now.
Several major museums are **completely free**, including the Topography of Terror, the Humboldt Forum Berlin exhibition, and the Berlin Wall Memorial.
My free walking tour passes right by Museum Island, the perfect introduction before you decide which museums to visit inside. Prices checked on 16 August 2026.
